user.title: HA Medic — AI Log Diagnostics
user.description: Connect an AI provider to analyze your Home Assistant logs. Get a free API key at console.groq.com (recommended) or openrouter.ai/keys.

data_description.ai_provider: groq and ollama are recommended for local/free usage
data_description.ai_key: Leave empty for ollama or lmstudio
data_description.ai_model: Leave empty to use the provider's default model

data_description.notify_service: e.g. mobile_app_your_phone — for push notifications with approve/decline buttons
data_description.include_addon_logs: Requires Home Assistant OS. Fetches logs from all running add-ons.
data_description.scan_interval: 0 disables automatic analysis. Use ha_medic.analyze service to trigger manually.
